planets.name: WASP-140 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-140 with a 2.24-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: WASP-140 b was found in 2016 by SuperWASP-South as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-140. Its orbit and size follow Alexoudi 2022's fit, the archive's default.
